newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures end mostly lower.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures end mostly lower.

text.p: June 20 - IMM currencies ended mostly lower, but key yen and mark contracts remained above weekly lows. Japan's economic reforms are seen weighing on yen in short term, but are long term positive. Sterling closed up after rising towards a four-week high. U.S. May budget deficit fell 8.6 pct vs a year ago. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750))
